curationNotes: Startup Gmail signature preflight passed for info@smallsitestudio.com. Git status had unrelated unstaged edits under offers/2026-05-14-0200-nightly, so this run used a fresh isolated batch and avoided those paths. Curated from live indexed Wix/small-site local-service pages during the 2026-05-16 2:00 AM run. Inspected 17 live candidate sites with Playwright, selected 10 with usable email contacts, visible service intent, source images/assets, and practical conversion cleanup needs. Previously batched URLs were checked and excluded before selection. Prototypes are to be GPT-5.5-authored one site per isolated sub-agent, no old scripted prototype generator.

items.name: Sparks' Pressure Washing
items.location: Nacogdoches, TX / Stephen F. Austin State University area
items.vertical: pressure washing for houses, driveways, porches, pools, and exterior surfaces
items.summary: Young owner-led pressure washing Wix site has a real story, phone, email, quote path, testimonials, and service categories, but the first screen and quote path still feel template-heavy and need stronger local trust and scan-friendly service proof.
items.angle: Preserve the blue pressure-washing Wix look while making the first screen clarify local service, free estimates, testimonials, and one obvious quote/contact path

items.name: Salty Sea Pressure Washing LLC

items.angle: Keep the coastal pressure-washing identity while tightening the hero around service area, no-obligation quotes, roof/house/flat-surface services, and fast quote requests
